gloss: sense of emptiness; feeling of meaninglessness

definitions.gloss: sense of emptiness; feeling of meaninglessness
definitions.explanation: A profound feeling that life or existence lacks meaning or purpose. A psychological state of emotional emptiness or void.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{達成|たっせい}した→達成する：04816_tassei⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{虚無感|きょむかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: After achieving my goal, I was overcome by a sense of emptiness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{虚無感|きょむかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えない→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: No matter what I do, this feeling of emptiness won't go away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{虚無感|きょむかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}った→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧。
examples.english: I fell into a deep sense of nihilism.

notes:
{虚無感|きょむかん} is related to philosophical nihilism and is commonly used in discussions of existential feelings.
